text.tspan: Share of people living in urban areas

The urban area is the share of people living in
cities
and
towns
, as estimated by the European Commission using
satellite imagery and census data. This differs from UN figures, which rely on national urban definitions.
Data source: European Commission, Joint Research Centre (JRC) (2025)
